healthdirect

Australia
Source checked 2026-08-14

Healthdirect is a free, government-funded 24-hour health advice line for all Australians. It provides access to registered nurses who can offer health advice, assess symptoms, and direct callers to appropriate local care.

  • Health
  • Navigation
CostFree resource finder.

Free to call and free to use, though call charges may apply from mobiles

AccessFree 24-hour phone line
Call 1800 022 222Open listing
Hours, location & source
Coverage
Nationwide telephone service covering all of Australia
Hours
24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
Phone
1800 022 222

Check before you go. Registered nurses provide advice 24/7. Mobile call charges may apply. Use the official page for interpreter and relay access. This is not an emergency-response service.

Sydney, Australia
Source checked 2026-08-14
